AI-System-Used.name: AI System Used
AI-System-Used.definition: The AI engine and/or the model name used to generate this media.

AI-System-Version-Used.name: AI System Version Used
AI-System-Version-Used.definition: The version of the AI system used to generate this media, if known.

AI-Prompt-Information.name: AI Prompt Information
AI-Prompt-Information.definition: The information that was given to the generative AI service as “prompt(s)” in order to generate this media.

AI-Prompt-Writer-Name.name: AI Prompt Writer Name
AI-Prompt-Writer-Name.definition: Name of the person who wrote the prompt used for generating this media.

Circa-Date-Created.name: Circa Date Created
Circa-Date-Created.definition: Approximate date or range of dates associated with the creation and production of a video.

Content-Warning.name: Content Warning
Content-Warning.definition: Information to warn potential viewers about nudity, violence etc in the video

Date-Created.name: Date Created
Date-Created.definition: Designates the date and optionally the time the content of the video was created (rather than the date of the creation of the digital representation)

Date-Modified.name: Date Modified
Date-Modified.definition: Date and optionally time when the video was modified last time

Date-Released.name: Date Released
Date-Released.definition: Date and optionally time of the public release of the video
Date-Released.datatype: Date (0..1) (Year only, Year-Month only, Year-Month-Day optional with time)

Digital-Source-Type.name: Digital Source Type
Digital-Source-Type.definition: The type of the source of this digital video, including whether the video was captured, digitised or generated.

Episode.name: Episode
Episode.definition: Episode in a specific season of a TV or video series this video is a member of.

External-Metadata-URL.name: External Metadata URL
External-Metadata-URL.definition: Link(s) to an external web resource for retrieval of further metadata about this video

Feed-Identifier.name: Feed Identifier
Feed-Identifier.definition: Identifier of the feed/source this video was delivered by

Metadata-Edit-Date.name: Metadata Edit Date
Metadata-Edit-Date.definition: Date of the last edit of the metadata of this video.

Metadata-Editor.name: Metadata Editor
Metadata-Editor.definition: Party doing the last edit of the metadata of this video.

Metadata-Authority.name: Metadata Authority
Metadata-Authority.definition: Party responsible for the accuracy of the metadata values.

Planning-Reference.name: Planning Reference
Planning-Reference.definition: Reference to a data item used for planning the shooting of this video

Publication-Event.name: Publication Event
Publication-Event.definition: Date and optionally the time of publishing this video with name and identifier for the event of this publication.

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.definition: How the video is classified by a public authority such as MPA

Ready-for-Release.name: Ready for Release
Ready-for-Release.definition: An indicator if this video is ready for being released to the public. This depends on rules by the party responsible for the publication.

Recording-Device.name: Recording Device
Recording-Device.definition: Device used for recording this video

Registry-Entry.name: Registry Entry
Registry-Entry.definition: Identifier of the video issued by an identified registry.

Review-Rating.name: Review Rating
Review-Rating.definition: An aesthetic rating given to the video by an external reviewer such as a news outlet.

Season.name: Season
Season.definition: Season of a TV or video series this video is a member of.

Series.name: Series
Series.definition: TV or video series this video is a member of.

Storyline-Identifier.name: Storyline Identifier
Storyline-Identifier.definition: Identifier(s) of a story evolving over time with which this video is associated

Style-Period.name: Style Period
Style-Period.definition: The style, historical or artistic period, movement, group, or school whose characteristics are represented by the video

Temporal-Coverage.name: Temporal Coverage
Temporal-Coverage.definition: Period of time covered by the video

Parent-Video-Identifier.name: Parent Video Identifier
Parent-Video-Identifier.definition: Globally unambiguous identifier of the video from which this video was derived.

Video-Identifier.name: Video Identifier
Video-Identifier.definition: Globally unambiguous identifier of the video regardless of renditions, formats, encodings etc. This identifier should be shared across all renditions.

Video-Rendition.name: Video Rendition
Video-Rendition.definition: Unambiguous identifier of the video specific to a rendition.

Video-Version.name: Video Version
Video-Version.definition: Version of the video identified by the Video Identifier

Workflow-Rating.name: Workflow Rating
Workflow-Rating.definition: An aesthetic rating given to the video by its creator or editor, for example to mark the best take of a series

Workflow-Tag.name: Workflow Tag
Workflow-Tag.definition: Indicator for the role of this video in a production workflow.

Alt-Text-Accessibility.name: Alt Text (Accessibility)
Alt-Text-Accessibility.definition: A brief textual description of the purpose and meaning of a video that can be accessed by assistive technology or displayed when the video is disabled in the browser. It should not exceed 250 characters.

CV-Term-About-the-Content.name: CV Term About the Content
CV-Term-About-the-Content.definition: What the video is about expressed by term(s) selected from taxonomies or controlled vocabularies

Data-Displayed-on-Screen.name: Data Displayed on Screen
Data-Displayed-on-Screen.definition: Text or other data shown in some region of the video.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Textual description of the content of the video

Dopesheet-Link.name: Dopesheet Link
Dopesheet-Link.definition: Link(s) to an external web resource providing a shotlist with descriptions

Extended-Description-Accessibility.name: Extended Description (Accessibility)
Extended-Description-Accessibility.definition: A more detailed textual description of the purpose and meaning of a video that elaborates on the information provided by the Alt Text (Accessibility) property. This property does not have a character limitation and is not required if the Alt Text (Accessibility) field sufficiently describes the video.

Featured-Organisation.name: Featured Organisation
Featured-Organisation.definition: Organisation(s) featured by the content of the video

Genre.name: Genre
Genre.definition: Artistic, style, journalistic, product or other genre(s) of the video.

Headline-.name: Headline
Headline-.definition: Short description of the content of the video

Keywords.name: Keywords
Keywords.definition: What the video is about expressed by a free choice of descriptive phrases or keywords

Location-Shot.name: Location Shot
Location-Shot.definition: Place from where the video was shot, in particular where the camera was located

Person-Heard.name: Person Heard
Person-Heard.definition: Person(s) who can be heard only in the video

Person-Shown.name: Person Shown
Person-Shown.datatype: Entity Structure or Person Details structure (0..unbounded)

Product-Shown.name: Product Shown
Product-Shown.definition: Product(s) identified by a GTIN code shown by the video

Snapshot-Link.name: Snapshot Link
Snapshot-Link.definition: A still image representing  the video.

Timed-Text-Link.name: Timed Text Link
Timed-Text-Link.definition: Link(s) to an external web resource providing a timed text track, used to provide captioning/subtitling or audio description of the video

Title.name: Title
Title.definition: Title of the video, should be a shorthand reference

Transcript-Link.name: Transcript Link
Transcript-Link.definition: Link(s) to an external web resource providing a transcription of the video

Visual-Colour.name: Visual Colour
Visual-Colour.definition: The visual colouring of the video.

Contributor.name: Contributor
Contributor.definition: Party or parties (person or organisation) which contributed to the video, refinement by the role attribute.

Copyright-Notice-.name: Copyright Notice
Copyright-Notice-.definition: Any textual notice necessary by legal needs or common use to indicate the current owner of the copyright of this media resource

Copyright-Year.name: Copyright Year
Copyright-Year.definition: Year of origin of the video, usually appearing in the copyright notice as a numeric value

Creator.name: Creator
Creator.definition: Party or parties (person or organisation) which created the video, refinement by the role attribute.

Credit-Line.name: Credit Line
Credit-Line.definition: Credit to person(s) and/or organisation(s) required by the supplier of the video (clip) to be used when published.

Data-Mining.name: Data Mining
Data-Mining.definition: Data mining prohibition or permission, optionally with constraints.

Other-Constraints.name: Other Constraints
Other-Constraints.definition: Additional constraints on the use of the asset.

Licensor-.name: Licensor
Licensor-.definition: Company or person to  be contacted for licensing

Model-Release-Document.name: Model Release Document
Model-Release-Document.definition: Identifier(s) of a Model Release document.

Model-Release-Status.name: Model Release Status
Model-Release-Status.definition: Summarises the availability and scope of model releases authorizing usage of the likenesses of persons appearing in the video

Property-Release-Document.name: Property Release Document
Property-Release-Document.definition: Identifier(s) of a Property Release document.

Property-Release-Status.name: Property Release Status
Property-Release-Status.definition: Summarises the availability and scope of property releases authorising usage of the properties appearing in the photograph.

Rights-Usage-Terms.name: Rights Usage Terms
Rights-Usage-Terms.definition: The licensing parameters of the video expressed in free-text.

Embedded-Encoded-Rights-Expression.name: Embedded Encoded Rights Expression
Embedded-Encoded-Rights-Expression.definition: Structure covering the assertion of rights, the granting of licenses and both in human and a machine readable ways (including restrictions, embargoes, duties ...)

Linked-Encoded-Rights-Expression.name: Linked Encoded Rights Expression
Linked-Encoded-Rights-Expression.definition: Structure covering the assertion of rights, the granting of licenses and both in human and a machine readable ways (including restrictions, embargoes, duties ...)

Copyright-Owner-.name: Copyright Owner
Copyright-Owner-.definition: Data identifying the individual or organisation owning the rights for this media resource which could be the video as a whole or a clip in a video. The optional role attribute may indicate which facet of rights is covered by this entity.

Supplier-.name: Supplier
Supplier-.definition: Supplier of this copy of the media resource

Source-Supply-Chain.name: Source (Supply Chain)
Source-Supply-Chain.definition: Person, party or system that has a role in the content supply chain.

Audio-Bitrate.name: Audio Bitrate
Audio-Bitrate.definition: Bit rate of the audio data depending on the Video Bit Rate Type: if fixed the fixed rate, if variable the maximum rate. The unit is bits per second.

Audio-Bitrate-Type.name: Audio Bitrate Type
Audio-Bitrate-Type.definition: Indicates if the bitrate of the audio data is fixed or variable

Audio-Bits-per-Sample.name: Audio Bits per Sample
Audio-Bits-per-Sample.definition: Number of bits used for an audio sample

Audio-Coding.name: Audio Coding
Audio-Coding.definition: Machine readable code and a human readable term for the used audio coding

Audio-Sample-Rate.name: Audio Sample Rate
Audio-Sample-Rate.definition: Rate used for sampling the audio

Display-Aspect-Ratio.name: Display Aspect Ratio
Display-Aspect-Ratio.definition: Ratio of width and height of the displayed image. (Width and height do not require to be in pixels.)

Editorial-Duration.name: Editorial Duration
Editorial-Duration.definition: Duration of the video content proposed for editorial use

Editorial-Duration-End.name: Editorial Duration End
Editorial-Duration-End.definition: The point in time and frames the content proposed for editorial use ends

Editorial-Duration-Start.name: Editorial Duration Start
Editorial-Duration-Start.definition: The point in time and frames the content proposed for editorial use starts

File-Bitrate.name: File Bitrate
File-Bitrate.definition: The total bit rate of the all media streams in this file.

File-Duration.name: File Duration
File-Duration.definition: Duration of the overall video (from the first to the last frame)

File-Format.name: File Format
File-Format.definition: Format of the file containing the video data.

Frame-Size.name: Frame Size
Frame-Size.definition: Size of the video frame in pixels

Media-Type.name: Media Type
Media-Type.definition: IANA Media Type of the video.

Orientation.name: Orientation
Orientation.definition: Orientation of the visual content of the video as defined by TIFF.
Orientation.datatype: Number (0..1) (TIFF 6.0 orientation - with a user guideline ("no flips"))

Signal-Aspect-Ratio.name: Signal Aspect Ratio
Signal-Aspect-Ratio.definition: Ratio of width and height in pixels of a frame

Signal-Format.name: Signal Format
Signal-Format.definition: Combined term including the size of the frame, interlaced/progressive, framerate

Stream-ready.name: Stream-ready
Stream-ready.definition: Indicates if this video can be used for streaming by the rule of having the key technical data of the video at the start rather than end of the file and that the wrapper and essense format are suitable for streaming

Video-Bitrate.name: Video Bitrate
Video-Bitrate.definition: Bit rate of the video data depending on the Video Bit Rate Type: if fixed the fixed rate, if variable the maximum rate. The unit is bits per second.

Video-Bitrate-Type.name: Video Bitrate Type
Video-Bitrate-Type.definition: Indicates if the bitrate of the video data is fixed or variable

Video-Coding.name: Video Coding
Video-Coding.definition: Machine readable code and a human readable term for the used video coding

Video-Profile.name: Video Profile
Video-Profile.definition: Name of the used video profile as defined by the maker of the encoding standard.

Video-Streams-Count.name: Video Streams Count
Video-Streams-Count.definition: Count of video streams in a video file.

Markers.name: Markers
Markers.definition: A marker describes a location in an audio or video sequence. It is used to identify for which part of the video (a clip of the video as a whole) a set of IPTC Video Metadata properties is used.

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Globally unique identifier of the concept

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Globally unique identifier of the concept

Role.name: Role
Role.definition: Identifier of the role the concept has in the context of the metadata property

CV-Term-CV-ID.name: CV-Term CV ID
CV-Term-CV-ID.definition: Globally unique identifier of the Controlled Vocabulary the term is from.

CV-Term-ID.name: CV-Term ID
CV-Term-ID.definition: Globally unique identifier of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary.

CV-Term-name.name: CV-Term name
CV-Term-name.definition: Natural language name of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary.

Refined-'aboutness'-of-the-CV-Term.name: Refined 'aboutness' of the CV-Term
Refined-'aboutness'-of-the-CV-Term.definition: Refinement of the 'about' relationship of the term with the content.

Manufacturer.name: Manufacturer
Manufacturer.definition: Name of the manufacturer of the device

Attached-Lens-Description.name: Attached Lens Description
Attached-Lens-Description.definition: Short description of the lens used with the device at the time of the recording

Owner´s-Device-ID.name: Owner´s Device ID
Owner´s-Device-ID.definition: Identifier assigned by the owner of the device

Rights-Expression-Language-ID.name: Rights Expression Language ID
Rights-Expression-Language-ID.definition: Identifier of the rights expression language used by the rights expression.

Encoding-type.name: Encoding type
Encoding-type.definition: Encoding type of the rights expression, identified by an IANA Media Type.

Encoded-Rights-Expression.name: Encoded Rights Expression
Encoded-Rights-Expression.definition: Embedded serialized rights expression using a rights expression language which is encoded as a string.

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Globally unique identifier of the entity

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Globally unique identifier of the entity

Role.name: Role
Role.definition: Identifier of the role the entity has in the context of the metadata property

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the episode or season of a series

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Number of the episode or season of a series

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Identifier of the episode or season of a series

Width.name: Width
Width.definition: Width of the video frame in pixels

Height.name: Height
Height.definition: Height of the video frame in pixels

Measure-Unit.name: Measure Unit
Measure-Unit.definition: Units of width and height values, fixed value "pixels"

Rights-Expression-Language-ID.name: Rights Expression Language ID
Rights-Expression-Language-ID.definition: Identifier of the rights expression language used by the rights expression.

Encoding-type.name: Encoding type
Encoding-type.definition: Encoding type of the rights expression, identified by an IANA Media Type.

Link-to-Encoded-Rights-Expression.name: Link to Encoded Rights Expression
Link-to-Encoded-Rights-Expression.definition: Link to a rights expression using a rights expression language.

Image-Link.name: Image Link
Image-Link.definition: Link URL locating the image resource

Image-Qualifier.name: Image Qualifier
Image-Qualifier.definition: Qualifier of the relationship of the image with the video

Image-Role.name: Image Role
Image-Role.definition: Role of this image in the context of the video

Image-Width.name: Image Width
Image-Width.definition: Width of the image, in pixels

Image-Height.name: Image Height
Image-Height.definition: Height of the image, in pixels

Used-Video-Frame.name: Used Video Frame
Used-Video-Frame.definition: Frame of the video used for this still image.

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Globally unique identifier of the location

Sublocation-name.name: Sublocation name
Sublocation-name.definition: Name of a sub location the Location is located in

City-name.name: City name
City-name.definition: Name of the city the Location is located in

State/Province-name.name: State/Province name
State/Province-name.definition: Name of the state or province the Location is located in

Country-name.name: Country name
Country-name.definition: Name of the country the Location is located in

Country-ISO-code.name: Country ISO code
Country-ISO-code.definition: ISO code of the country the Location is located in

World-region-name.name: World region name
World-region-name.definition: Name of the world region the Location is located in

GPS-Longitude.name: GPS-Longitude
GPS-Longitude.definition: Longitude of a WGS84 based position of this Location

GPS-Latitude.name: GPS-Latitude
GPS-Latitude.definition: Latitude of a WGS84 based position of this Location

GPS-Altitude.name: GPS-Altitude
GPS-Altitude.definition: Altitude in meters of a WGS84 based position of this Location

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Globally unique identifier of the person

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: A textual description of the person

Characteristics.name: Characteristics
Characteristics.definition: A property or trait of the person

GTIN.name: GTIN
GTIN.definition: A 14 digit GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) of the product (GTIN-8 to GTIN-14 codes are used).

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: A textual description of the product.

Publication-Date.name: Publication Date
Publication-Date.definition: Date and optionally the time of publishing the video

Publication-Event-Name.name: Publication Event Name
Publication-Event-Name.definition: Name of the event for publishing this video.

Publication-Event-Identifier.name: Publication Event Identifier
Publication-Event-Identifier.definition: Identifier of the event for publishing this video

Qualifier.name: Qualifier
Qualifier.definition: Term qualifying the use of the link

Qualifier.name: Qualifier
Qualifier.definition: Term qualifying the use of the link

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Language of the content at the link location

Rating-Value.name: Rating Value
Rating-Value.definition: Rating value as issued by the rating source

Rating-Source-Link.name: Rating Source Link
Rating-Source-Link.definition: Link to the site and optionally the page of the party which has issued the rating value, linked resource should explain the rating rules.

Rating-Scale-Min-Value.name: Rating Scale Min Value
Rating-Scale-Min-Value.definition: The value of the rating scale used for the lowest/worst rating

Rating-Scale-Max-Value.name: Rating Scale Max Value
Rating-Scale-Max-Value.definition: The value of the rating scale used for the highest/best rating

Rating-Value-Logo.name: Rating Value Logo
Rating-Value-Logo.definition: Visualisation of the rating value referenced by a link

Rating-Region.name: Rating Region
Rating-Region.definition: Geopolitical region to which this rating applies.

Asset-Identifier.name: Asset Identifier
Asset-Identifier.definition: Unique identifier of the video as issued by a registry

Registry-Identifier.name: Registry Identifier
Registry-Identifier.definition: An identifier for the registry which issued the identifier of the video.

Role.name: Role
Role.definition: An identifier of the reason and/or purpose for this Registry Entry.

From-Date.name: From Date
From-Date.definition: Optionally truncated date when the temporal coverage starts

To-Date.name: To Date
To-Date.definition: Optionally truncated date when the temporal coverage ends

Measure-Type.name: Measure Type
Measure-Type.definition: How the measures of the rectangle are expressed

Rectangle-upper-left-X.name: Rectangle, upper left X
Rectangle-upper-left-X.definition: Horizontal axis value of the upper left corner of the rectange

Rectangle-upper-left-Y.name: Rectangle, upper left Y
Rectangle-upper-left-Y.definition: Vertical axis value of the upper left corner of the rectange

Time-Format.name: Time Format
Time-Format.definition: Identifier of the time format. For time code formats following SMPTE specifications.
Time-Format.datatype:
Text value from CV (1)
Enumeration:
- normalPlayTime
- smpteTC24
- smpteTC25
- smpteTC2997
- smpteTC2997drop
- smpteTC30
- smpteTC50
- smpteTC5994
- smpteTC5994drop
- smpteTC60
- smpteTC23976

Time-Value.name: Time Value
Time-Value.definition: Formated string including hours, minutes, seconds, fractions of seconds or frames, depending on the Time Format

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Globally unique identifier of the entity

Circa-Date-Created.name: Circa Date Created
Circa-Date-Created.definition: Approximate date or range of dates associated with the creation and production of an artwork or object or its components.

Content-Description.name: Content Description
Content-Description.definition: A textual description of the content depicted in the artwork or object.

Contribution-Description.name: Contribution Description
Contribution-Description.definition: A textual description about a contribution made to an artwork or an object.

Copyright-Notice.name: Copyright Notice
Copyright-Notice.definition: Contains any necessary copyright notice for claiming the intellectual property for artwork or an object in the image and should identify the current owner of the copyright of this  work with associated intellectual property rights.

Creator.name: Creator
Creator.definition: Contains the name of the artist who has created artwork or an object in the  image. In cases where the artist could or should not be identified the name of a company or organisation may be appropriate.

Creator-ID.name: Creator ID
Creator-ID.definition: Globally unique identifier for the creator of artwork or object.

Current-Copyright-Owner-ID.name: Current Copyright Owner ID
Current-Copyright-Owner-ID.definition: Globally unique identifier for the current owner of the copyright of the artwork or object.

Current-Copyright-Owner-Name.name: Current Copyright Owner Name
Current-Copyright-Owner-Name.definition: Name of the current owner of the copyright of the artwork or object.

Current-Licensor-ID.name: Current Licensor ID
Current-Licensor-ID.definition: Globally unique identifier for the current licensor of the artwork or object.

Current-Licensor-Name.name: Current Licensor Name
Current-Licensor-Name.definition: Name of the current licensor of the artwork or object.

Date-Created.name: Date Created
Date-Created.definition: Designates the date and optionally the time the artwork or object in the image was created. This relates to artwork or objects with associated intellectual property rights.

Physical-Description.name: Physical Description
Physical-Description.definition: A textual description of the physical characteristics of the artwork or object, without reference to the content depicted.

Source.name: Source
Source.definition: The organisation or body holding and registering the artwork or object in the image for inventory purposes.

Source-Inventory-Number.name: Source Inventory Number
Source-Inventory-Number.definition: The inventory number issued by the organisation or body holding and registering the artwork or object in the image.

Source-Inventory-URL.name: Source Inventory URL
Source-Inventory-URL.definition: URL reference to the metadata record of the inventory maintained by the Source.

Style-Period.name: Style Period
Style-Period.definition: The style, historical or artistic period, movement, group, or school whose characteristics are represented in the artwork or object.
